title: Linear–quadratic system on a graph
subtitle: Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables  · 11 official questions

sections.heading: Where this sits for you
body: **11 of the official questions in Nonlinear equations in one variable and systems of equations in two variables  are this one** — 8 Easy, 3 Medium, 0 Hard.
It is bottom-heavy, which makes it cheap points. Secure it early.

sections.heading: How to spot it
body: You are looking at this pattern when:
- You get a graph of a parabola and a line and must find the solution (the intersection), or you get equations and must pick the matching graph, or you get a graph and must pick the matching system.
- The choices are either four graphs or four systems of equations.

sections.heading: The method
body: - 1) The solution is the intersection point, so read its coordinates.
- 2) To match equations to a graph, compare features one at a time: the parabola's vertex from vertex form (or its intercepts and direction of opening), and the line's slope and y-intercept.
- 3) Eliminate choices that fail any one feature.

sections.heading: Where Desmos fits
body: Type each choice's system and see which one reproduces the picture, or type the given system and compare it with the choice graphs.
Click the intersection to get the exact point.
